records.text: Katie Zacharia said the Department of War selected Cleveland, Ohio for a 46,000-square-foot US Navy submarine component repair center to manufacture, repair and maintain parts for virtually all new and existing submarines.
records.speaker: Katie Zacharia

appearances.snippet: the president also announced the Department of War has officially selected Cleveland, Ohio as the new home for the U.S. Navy's submarine component repair center, this massive 46,000 square foot facility. ... will manufacture, repair, and maintain key parts for virtually all new and existing submarines.
